commits.subject: Stop operator credential helpers answering tenant Git operations
commits.body:
WD-22: a tenant-scoped host Git operation receives its per-operation
credential through GIT_ASKPASS, but Git asks configured credential helpers
first. An operator-level helper (`store`, a keychain) therefore answered
with the operator's own credential — reaching whatever the operator can —
and `store` would save the tenant's installation token into the
operator's ~/.git-credentials. A materialized credential now resets the
inherited helper list unless the caller configured its own helpers
(verified with `git credential fill`).
